column1: # The Linux system calls the stdlib and the compiler make that the hosted Windows runtime (stdlib/abla/runtime/platform/windows/entry.ab) does
# not translate: such a call ends the program with status 70, "unsupported Linux system call N". Each line names the call site and says why
# that is right (ok: the path is not taken on Windows) or what is missing (gap: a Windows program can reach it). tools/test-windows-syscall-coverage.sh
# fails on a call site of an untranslated number that no line names (326 was one, and a default build died of it), and on a line whose call
# site is gone or whose number is translated now: a gap that gets a translation loses its line.

column3: ok: or gap: and why
ok: rt_sigaction; bootstrapCtSigaction answers false first on Windows (the compile-time guard uses 4004/4005)
ok: resets SIGPIPE in a forked child; a Windows program starts children with spawn (4001), there is no fork
gap: pread64, reading ELF files for the relocation check; not translated
ok: dup2 in the fork/exec child of the compile-time process; Windows spawns (4001)
gap: dup2 to silence the REPL's standard error; the REPL is not run on Windows (not checked)
ok: dup2 of a redirect in the forked child; Windows spawns (4001)
ok: setitimer; answered false first on Windows (linuxHostIsWindows)
gap: link (hard link) of a codegen unit; not translated
gap: chmod behind Path.setPermissions; fchmod (91) is translated, chmod is not
gap: rt_sigtimedwait of the TCP server's SIGTERM shutdown; Windows has no signals to take
gap: setrlimit (stack limits); getrlimit (97) is translated
ok: tgkill, the emulated thread-local storage of Android/Linux; Windows has loader TLS
gap: utimes touching a codegen unit; not translated
gap: inotify_add_watch; file watching is not translated on Windows
gap: symlinkat of the secure directory API; Windows creates links differently (not translated)
gap: signalfd4 of the signal watch (tests/cases/modules/signal-watch.ab); Windows has no POSIX signals
gap: signalfd4 of the TCP server's SIGTERM shutdown
gap: inotify_init1; file watching is not translated on Windows
gap: renameat2 of the secure directory API; renameat (264) is translated
